title: Senior QA Lead
jobDescription: • Design and develop software Products using Angular and Microsoft technologies. • Own QA strategy, planning, execution, reporting, and process improvement across multiple products and release cycles. • Review plan.md documents, requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and missing test scenarios • Define risk-based test plans, quality gates, entry and exit criteria, and release-readiness standards.

title: Associate UX Designer
jobDescription: • Support end-to-end UX work: research, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI • Assist with user interviews, surveys, and usability tests; help synthesize findings into personas, journey maps, and actionable insights • Design and iterate on flows in Figma, incorporating feedback from design critiques • Use AI tools (e.g., Figma AI, Chat GPT/Claude, Midjourney or similar) to accelerate ideation, generate variations, and speed up early-stage exploration — while personally reviewing, curating, and refining every output before it goes further
